scope: known local native query exposure before SAFAL development parameter selection
evidence_policy: Union of native test/test_public IDs in saved prediction/record JSONL, query/split manifests and native fresh-probe reports. Partial historical run manifests and explicit past-measured query exclusions are conservatively treated as exposed. Full dataset inventories, including milestone2/split_manifest.jsonl image-role assignment, are excluded. No archive extraction or new inference was used.
limitations: The five categories have already informed development; fresh images establish a conditional held-out image check, not a globally unseen category benchmark.
This ledger covers retained local histories and their copies; it cannot establish that no external or undocumented observation ever occurred.
Native labels are read only to establish the declared balanced sampling strata; parameter search must use the existing development queries only.
